input.auxiliary: (fast signed temperature - slow signed temperature)/0.05K, or zero in raw condition

design.controlled_comparison: Within each architecture/topology/seed, only auxiliary channel masking changes
design.teacher: previous known absolute-error two-timescale controller; states never input
design.initialization: zero actor head: all models begin with rate .255/s
design.checkpoint_rule: final fixed-budget model; retain all curves, no best checkpoint selection
limitations: not reinforcement learning or RL sample-efficiency evidence
same signed filter form across models; not calibrated AFD physiology
chemical topology ablation keeps real gap/input/output assumptions
generic GRU has different dynamics and readout; GRU2 is only near parameter matched
all rewired topologies crossed with training seeds, not selected for success
64 behavior episodes are not 64 independent trained models
holdouts are exploratory and retired after inspection

execution.strategy: unchanged original CLI in isolated per-case subprocesses
